artifacts: unique target directory marker and retained source/target ownership
build_recipe.reconstruct: extract archive into a unique temporary source root; verify every manifest hash; apply candidate patch/overlays; verify changed overlays and git/apply status; remove only after replay receipts pass
build_recipe.scope_limit: Rebuilt executables are not promised byte-identical; retained 0885 native/allocator binaries are the baseline artifacts.

limitations: No timings, RSS, Cargo builds, or workloads were run for this static review.
The real worksheet/document controls cover codec and stream MCE paths but are not a complete OOXML package differential.
The existing differential command itself does not compare two binaries; an external verifier must enforce full equality and coverage.

semantics: Codec and stream count namespace declarations among per-tag/per-event attributes.
Namespace binding budget counts previously unseen in-scope prefixes; a same-prefix shadowing rebind does not add a binding.
Stream applies the tighter processing and per-event attribute limit and validates public bounds before input.
Codec uses checked attribute iteration; duplicate/error precedence and source order are observable.

static_findings: Uses exact 0885 native and 0887 native retained binary paths and verifies hashes against 0887 plan.
Uses fresh create-only run folders and stops on first child failure; no retries/replacements.
Snapshots are explicitly non-atomic and can miss short-lived peaks; polling perturbs the run, so this is diagnostic RSS evidence only.
The script writes plan.json before running and uses the repository root as benchmark cwd; this should remain recorded in the packet.
monitor_review.workload_protocol: 4 AB/BA blocks, warmup 3, samples 200, CPU 12, observer CPU 13, /usr/bin/time plus sampled /proc status/smaps, no latency/adoption claim

correctness: Codec: output SHA-256 plus Report and exact typed/displayed error; differential mce_baseline/mce_bare records both.
Stream: semantic event SHA-256, raw observer SHA-256, Report, counts, and exact error/precedence.
Compare complete before/after JSON with fixed package/member/generated/aliasing counts; timing JSON is not semantic evidence.
harness_notes: adversarial builds input before timing and times only Case.run, but deduplicates outcomes; assert every retained sample has the same outcome and retain a count.

differential uses deterministic BTreeMap output and seeded generated/aliasing corpora, but silently skips unreadable package/member/archive errors; fail or record those skips and bind expected counts.
Existing benign adversarial wrappers return only codec output SHA/error and omit Report; use differential or a separate correctness replay for reports.
Observer callbacks are part of stream timing; use identical callbacks in both legs and keep callback-free/control counts separate.

allocation_boundary: For an inline-four storage change, assert 4-to-5 transition with fallible spill and preserve typed Error::Allocation/source behavior under injected allocation failure; this is outside the wall-time harness.
boundaries: distinct namespace prefixes at exact max_namespace_bindings and one over, plus same-prefix shadowing
directive token counts at exact max_directive_tokens and one over
depth, input/output bytes, stream event/attribute bytes, context bytes, and expanded-name bytes exact and one over
keep declaration/long-URI/shadowed-chain/hoisting floods as separate safety controls, not primary latency cases
